title: Elk Grove, CA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Elk Grove, CA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Elk Grove is a city in CA with a population of 176,124. Sacramento suburb with diversity, parks, and more affordable than Bay Area. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 265 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
